_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change agenda-formalities-hamerstukken (REQ-AFH-001, matrix row age-07). An agenda item can be marked as a formality (hamerstuk) and, once the chair adopts the formalities together on the live screen, records that it was adopted without debate and when. The live screen used to look for a 'hamerstuk' tag nothing could set and wrote status: completed, which AgendaItem does not declare.

isFormality.title: Formality
isFormality.description: A formality (hamerstuk) is adopted together with the other formalities, without debate. The chair or secretary marks it on the meeting's agenda.

formalityOutcome.title: Formality outcome
formalityOutcome.description: Set when the chair adopts the formalities together on the live screen.
